# SequentialLearn

> A modern mastery-based LMS where every unit must be earned: watch the lesson, take notes (by voice if you like), pass the quiz, then unlock the next unit.

SequentialLearn is built around sequential unlocking, voice-enabled notes, exportable unit PDFs, and a distraction-free learning player.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and featured courses.
- [Courses](/courses): Browse the full course marketplace.
- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to your account.
- [Create account](/register): Create a free student account.
